'''Jhaka Bakarn''', [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] '''Jhaka Bakvalen''',<ref name="Codex" /> was a dark-[[Hair/Legends|haired]] and light-skinned [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Old" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]]. She was the eldest daughter of the affluent [[Bakarn family|Bakvalen family]] on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] generations before the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. However, Jhaka shunned her noble life and instead joined the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] as a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], causing her furious [[Jhaka Bakarn's father|father]] to disown her.<ref name="Codex" />

Jhaka changed her surname to the more common "Bakarn" and went on to become a renowned fighter ace in charge of her own [[Jhaka Bakarn's squadron|squadron]]. However, she was ultimately [[Death/Legends|killed]] leading her [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] to victory over a dangerous [[Unidentified warlord (Jhaka Bakarn)|warlord]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], prompting her grieving father to change the family name to Bakarn in her honor.<ref name="Codex" /> Bakarn was memorialized by a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] in [[Guardian Hold Four|Bakvalen Hall]], the family's house on Corellia.<ref name="Old" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jhaka Bakarn appeared in a hologram in the [[Jedi Consular]] mission "Old Blood" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Old" />
